text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! You have plans to run with Prez
too, Tsuru?
Are you sure you got the
right day—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
She does indeed. You're both in the
right place.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I figured the optimal way to hone our
running is
through a mutually beneficial
rivalry.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
We're all rough stones in need of
polishing—our
rivalry will sand down our
imperfections, allowing
our true
potential to shine through. So, what say

you?

text_block_list.name: Teio & Tsurumaru
text_block_list.text:
Okay... Then I'm gonna shine the
brightest!
Okay... Then I'll shine the
brightest!
